prompt:
Use the attached reference image as the exact character design reference.
Generate a full-body 2D side-scrolling sprite sheet for Unity using this character. Keep the character in the same style as the reference image. The character must remain visually consistent across all frames. Make the animation feel crisp, readable, and game-ready, with confident weight shifts, clear pose silhouettes, and expressive motion timing appropriate for responsive 2D gameplay.
Create a clean orthographic side-view sprite sheet. The character should face RIGHT in every frame only. Full body must be visible in every frame. Keep the camera fixed, keep the character at a consistent scale, keep the ground level consistent, and keep the body centered within each frame. No perspective change, no motion blur, no extra props, no extra characters, no cropped limbs, and no background details.
Output one complete sprite sheet laid out on a single uniform grid of 13 columns by 4 rows. Every cell in every row must be exactly the same size (256x256 pixels), including the empty padding around the character. Rows with fewer frames than the grid width must leave their remaining trailing cells completely empty — never stretch the frames of a shorter row to fill the row width. Draw thin light gray grid lines exactly on every cell boundary, with perfectly uniform spacing, so each cell is clearly separated and the sheet can be sliced evenly. Place the character at the same position inside every cell: centered horizontally, and keep the feet on the exact same ground baseline in EVERY cell of EVERY row — the ground level must be identical across the entire sheet, not just within one row. Use a plain solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background inside every cell, perfectly uniform with no gradient, no vignette, and no shadows, so the background can be removed later. Do not add any text, UI, captions, labels, or decorative borders.
Arrange the sprite sheet in separate animation rows:
Row 1: WALK cycle, 7 frames. Smooth looping side-walk animation with natural foot placement, subtle body bob, and relaxed forward momentum.
Row 2: RUN cycle, 9 frames. Faster and more energetic than walking, smooth looping animation with stronger forward lean, wider stride arcs, and dynamic but controlled motion.
Row 3: BASIC ATTACK, 10 frames. One full attack motion with clear anticipation, action, impact, and recovery, returning to the starting pose. Make the attack readable and forceful, with strong staging and a clear impact frame.
Row 4: DEATH animation, 13 frames. Clear hit reaction followed by collapse, ending in a defeated pose on the ground. Make the fall readable, dramatic, and grounded while keeping the character fully inside each cell.
Important requirements:
- Keep the character proportions, outfit, and color palette identical in every frame.
- Make walk and run loop cleanly from the last frame back to the first frame.
- Keep the feet on one identical ground baseline across every row and every cell of the sheet.
- Keep silhouettes clear and readable for gameplay.
- Keep each frame fully inside its own cell, never touching or crossing cell boundaries.
- All cells must be identical in size, including padding, so the sheet can be sliced evenly on a uniform grid.
If supported, also export each individual frame separately using names like: walk_01 to walk_07, run_01 to run_09, attack_01 to attack_10, and death_01 to death_13. If separate frame export is not supported, generate only the complete sprite sheet.
